title: Can We Terraform the Sahara to Stop Climate Change?
summary: Real Engineering examines whether greening the Sahara could draw down carbon and slow climate change. It concludes that the effort would be enormously costly and that changes in albedo and other effects undercut the climate benefit.
why: Recommended in tree-planting and carbon removal threads as a sourced explanation of why greening deserts is not a simple climate fix.

quote.text: I recommend watching the video - it explains it better and goes into detail - it cites its own sources.
